content: Kwɨbhu, abhahiiri bhaanɨ, mwimɨɨrɨrɨ bhwɨma kukwisega Ʉmʉkʉrʉ. Nɨbhasɨɨgirɨ na niriigomba bhʉkʉngʼu kʉbharora imwɨ, abhasaani bhaanɨ. Imwɨ, ne‑bhozomerwa bhwanɨ na nɨ‑mʉbhanʉ gwanɨ gʉnʉ nɨhɨɨrwɨ komeremo gɨnʉ nɨkʉrirɨ.
Amaangirijʉ ga Paaurʉ
Nɨrabhiisasaama bhʉkʉngʼu Ɨʉdiya na Sintikɨ bhabhɨ nu ubhwɨndi bhʉmwɨ, kʉ kʉbha bharatuna Ʉmʉkʉrʉ Yɨɨsu.

Na naawɨ omohocha ʉmʉkɨndichanɨ omoheene, nɨrasabha ʉbhasakiryɨ abhakari bhabhɨrɨ bhayo bhabhɨ nu ubhwɨndi bhʉmwɨ. Bhabhɨrɨ bhayo bhʉʉsi bhakiikongʼeererya bhʉkʉngʼu hamwɨmwɨ na niinyɨ kʉ kʉraganʼya Ɨngʼana Ɨnzʉmu igʉrʉ wa Yɨɨsu Kiriisitʉ. Naatu abhakari bhayo bhaarɨ bharakora emeremo hamwɨmwɨ na Kɨrɨmɨnti na abhahocha abhakɨndichanɨ abhandɨ. Amariina ga abhaatʉ bhayo bhʉʉsi gaandikirwɨ mʉkɨtabhʉ chʉ ʉbhʉhʉru.
Mozomerwe sikʉ zʉʉsi, ku kugwatana nʉ Ʉmʉkʉrʉ Yɨɨsu, nɨrabhuga naatu, mozomerwe!
Ʉbhʉnyʉʉhu bhwanyu bhomenyekanɨ kʉbhaatʉ bhʉʉsi. Ʉmʉkʉrʉ Yɨɨsu arɨ haguhɨ kuuza.
Mutigɨ kwitiimaata kwa kegero chʉchʉsi, nawe kʉmangʼana gʉʉsi, kʉ kʉmʉsabha na kwisasaama, hamwɨmwɨ na kukumya, ubhwɨndi bhwanyu bhomenyekanɨ kwa Mungu.
Kʉgayo, omorembe gwa Mungu gʉnʉ gʉkʉkɨra amangʼɨɨni gʉʉsi ga abhaatʉ, gʉrariibha zekoro na amangʼɨɨni gaanyu, ku kugwatana na Yɨɨsu Kiriisitʉ.

Akʉmara, abhahiiri bhaanɨ, amangʼana gʉgʉʉsi ga amaheene, gʉgʉʉsi ganʉ gakwenderwa kusuukwa, gʉgʉʉsi ge eheene, gʉgʉʉsi ganʉ gatiisangiryɨ nʉ ʉbhʉbhɨ, gʉgʉʉsi ganʉ gakozomera, gʉgʉʉsi ganʉ ganu ubhukumuka ʉbhʉzʉmu, bhʉraabheho ʉbhʉzʉmu bhwʉbhwʉsi, bhʉraabheho ubhukumuka bhwʉbhwʉsi, mugiiseege amangʼana gayo.
Mongʼehe kokora garya mwigirɨ na kʉgasʉngʼaana kurwa kwa niinyɨ, ganʉ mwigwirɨ nɨgambirɨ, na kʉgarora nɨkʉrirɨ. Neho, Mungu wʉnʉ akʉbhaha omorembe, araangʼehe kʉbha hamwɨmwɨ na niimwɨ.
Paaurʉ arakumya Abhafiripi

Mmbe, nɨzʉmɨɨrwɨ bhʉkʉngʼu ku kugwatana nʉ Ʉmʉkʉrʉ Yɨɨsu, kʉ kʉbha mʉtɨnɨrʉ mʉtangirɨ naatu kunyiiseegera. Nɨɨzɨ kʉbha sikʉ zʉʉsi mwarɨ mʉranyiiseegera, nawe mʉkatamwa ɨnzɨra yʉ ʉkʉtʉma ʉbhʉsakirya bhwanyu kwa niinyɨ.
Nɨtakʉgambabhu kʉ kʉbha ninu ubhwɨndi, zɨyi. Niigirɨ kotoosa kwa bhwikari bhwʉbhwʉsi.

Nangʉ niigirɨ kwikara ɨkɨhabhɨ, na niigirɨ kwikara ikiniibhi. Niigirɨ kotoosa na gʉʉsi ganʉ gakombona, ɨbhɨ ribhaga ryɨ ɨnzara, hamwɨ ribhaga ryu umwigʉtʉ, ribhaga ryʉ ʉkʉbha na bhyaru, hamwɨ ribhaga ryu ukusuuhirwa.
Nɨranaja kokora gʉʉsi gayo, kʉ kʉbha Kiriisitʉ newe akongʼa amanaga.
Nawe, mʉkakora bhwaheene kugwatana na niinyɨ mʉnyaakʉ yɨnʉ naarɨ nayo.

Chɨmbu mwɨzɨ Abhafiripi imwɨ, hanʉ natangirɨ kobheerekeererya Ɨngʼana Ɨnzʉmu, na hanʉ naruurɨ mucharʉ chanyu cha Makɨdʉniya, imwɨ imubheene mwarɨ mʉransakirya. Risengerero ryanyu iryene neryo ryarɨ hamwɨmwɨ na niinyɨ kʉmangʼana gu ukuhurucha na kʉsʉngʼaana ebhegero.
Nʉʉrʉ hanʉ naarɨ mʉrʉbhɨri rwa Tɨsarʉʉnikɨ, mʉkantʉmɨra inyɨ ebhegero bhyʉ ʉkʉnsakirya, na ɨtaarɨ rogendo rʉmwɨ.
Nɨtakʉgambabhu kʉ kʉbha nereenda kʉsʉngʼaana ebhegero kurwa kwa niimwɨ, zɨyi. Nawe nɨsɨɨgirɨ nerore ʉrʉbhangʉ rʉnʉ Mungu arɨɨbhahɨ kubhweryakoro bhwanyu.
Nangʉ, ebhegero bhyʉsi bhɨnʉ mwantumiirɨ kwa Ɨpafurʉditʉ, nɨbhɨsʉngʼaanirɨ. Bhyisirɨ kʉmara ubhwɨndi bhwanɨ bhwʉsi, na ni‑bhyaru kʉkɨra bhɨnʉ nɨɨndirɨ. Ʉbhʉsakirya bhuyo bhʉbhɨɨrɨ nchi ikimweso
cho omoretyo ʉmʉzʉmu, ikimweso kɨnʉ kiriisiriribhwa na kozomeerya Mungu.
Mmbe, Mungu waanɨ, arabhaha ubhwɨndi bhwanyu bhwʉsi kʉrɨngʼaana nu ubhuniibhi bhʉ ʉbhʉgʉngʉ bhwazɨ, kʉnzɨra ya Yɨɨsu Kiriisitʉ.
Bhaabha wɨɨtʉ Mungu agungibhwɨ kemerano! Garamɨ.
Amangʼana gɨ ɨtɨnɨrʉ
Mʉbhakeerye bhanʉ bhʉʉsi bhakwisirirya Yɨɨsu Kiriisitʉ bha Firipi. Abhiisirirya bhanʉ bhakohokerya hamwɨmwɨ na niinyɨ, bhʉʉsi bharabhakeerya.
Na abhiisirirya bhʉʉsi bhanʉ bhakwikara mʉrʉbhɨri rʉnʉ bharabhakeerya, kɨnda abhasakirya bhanʉ bhakwikara munyumba ya Kaisaari.
Ɨbhɨgʉngi bhyʉ Ʉmʉkʉrʉ wɨɨtʉ Yɨɨsu Kiriisitʉ bhɨbhɨ hamwɨmwɨ na niimwɨ. Garamɨ.
